decisions.reason: The DPA management tooling fits the firm's stated compliance direction for agencies, costs little to maintain once built, and shows no performance shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.

As the flagship agency platform shown on the home page and central to the firm's strategic direction, it embodies the firm's aspirations and would be supported with slack rather than dropped after one year.

A configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business, uses existing infrastructure, and has a dedicated page, so there is little reason to withdraw it without evidence of underperformance.
